topic: Sensor data ingestion after firmware update
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the procedure for sensor data to appear in the analytics/MOPs database following a firmware update. It was clarified that data appears when the sensors come online. [me] explained that manual intervention is required when a list of unlisted boxes (e.g., 100,500 units) is available. In such cases, running a script to register the entire list is necessary; typically, 80-90% of the boxes are already registered.

[me] provided a Python script for this process.
decisions: Data appears in the database when sensors come online.
action_items: Attempt to run the provided Python script using available credentials and VPN access.
